# crlrenewal

```go
import "github.com/effective-security/trustyca/server/tasks/crlrenewal"
```

Package crlrenewal is the crl\_renewal task: on every run it publishes the CRLs that are due for the Active and Archived issuers of every org and the platform, through the CRL publisher of internal/ca that the PublishCrls method of the CA service uses \(DESIGN.md section 8\). A CRL is due when the issuer has none, or when the current one is within the crl\_renewal period of the issuer settings of its next update; the task runs at once when scheduled, so a new deployment serves CRLs without waiting for the first tick. Every published CRL records a CrlPublished event. Several instances may run the task: the DB refuses a CRL number that is not greater than the issuer's, so the instance that publishes second keeps the other's CRL.

```
tasks:
  - name: crl_renewal
    schedule: "every 10 minutes"
```

func (t *Task) Run(ctx context.Context) (*core.PublishCrlsResult, error)
